logger.message: #['[MCP] OBO | Tool: mcp-get-compliance-report | InitiatedBy: ' ++ vars.initiatedBy ++ ' | CorrelationID: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | OBO: ' ++ (vars.oboToken[0 to 39] default 'N/A')]
logger.doc:name: Log OBO Token

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { reportGeneratedAt: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, environment: vars.reqEnvironment, totalApplications: 0, error: "Environment '" ++ vars.reqEnvironment ++ "' was not found in your Anypoint organization.", availableEnvironments: vars.allEnvNames, suggestion: "Please retry with one of the available environment names listed above." }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var apps = payload.content default [] var filtered = if (vars.reqAppName == "all") apps else apps filter ($.name contains vars.reqAppName) fun getRuntimeVersion(app) = ((app.artifact.muleVersion.version) default (app.artifact.muleVersion default "unknown")) as String fun getAppStatus(app) = app.currentStatus default app.desiredStatus default "UNKNOWN" fun isCompliant(app) = (getRuntimeVersion(app) startsWith "4.9" or getRuntimeVersion(app) startsWith "4.8" or getRuntimeVersion(app) startsWith "4.7") and (getAppStatus(app) == "RUNNING" or getAppStatus(app) == "STARTED" or getAppStatus(app) == "APPLIED") --- { reportGeneratedAt: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, environment: vars.envName, totalApplications: sizeOf(filtered), applications: filtered map (app) -> { name: app.name default "unknown", status: getAppStatus(app), runtimeVersion: getRuntimeVersion(app), complianceStatus: if (isCompliant(app)) "COMPLIANT" else "NON_COMPLIANT", issues: ([] ++ (if (!(getAppStatus(app) == "RUNNING" or getAppStatus(app) == "STARTED" or getAppStatus(app) == "APPLIED")) ["App not running: " ++ getAppStatus(app)] else []) ++ (if (!(getRuntimeVersion(app) startsWith "4.9" or getRuntimeVersion(app) startsWith "4.8" or getRuntimeVersion(app) startsWith "4.7")) ["Runtime below minimum 4.7: " ++ getRuntimeVersion(app)] else []) ) } }

logger.message: #['[MCP] OBO | Tool: mcp-write-ado-log | InitiatedBy: ' ++ vars.initiatedBy ++ ' | CorrelationID: ' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' | OBO: ' ++ (vars.oboToken[0 to 39] default 'N/A')]
logger.doc:name: Log OBO Token
